    print('held-reference max absolute residual by bank:', {k: [float(np.max(np.abs(v[bank == b]))) for b in range(4)] for k,v in dict(pools, bank=loo).items()})
    print('leave-one-check-out worst verifier gap per budget:', worst_gap.tolist(), 'worst field max error:', worst_field)
